Date: 2027-03-07T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick post-demo recap + ask on volumes/budget

Hi Sonia — great to meet earlier, thanks for walking us through Nimbus Health's ingestion and triage flow. Quick recap and two asks so we can put together conservative committed scenarios for procurement: 

Recap from call (high level):
- Primary workload: medical record ingestion + summarization + question-answering for clinicians.
- Expected query pattern: bursty during business hours, mostly short prompts (~75-150 tokens request; 200-400 tokens response typical).
- Current pilot: daily volume ~0.5–1M tokens/day; expected growth as pilot expands.

Two asks to size options:
1) Confirm projected steady-state monthly tokens (range is fine) — we discussed 10–30M/month as a plausible ramp.
2) Budget range you can commit to in year 1 for API spend (monthly or quarterly).

What we'll do next once we have those: prepare 1) on-demand vs committed per-1M comparisons, 2) a 12/24-month committed-use proposal with multi-year sweeteners, and 3) how the startup program credit would layer in if you qualify.

If you prefer, I can give an immediate ballpark in a follow-up message once you confirm the token range and budget. Ben is looped on procurement questions and will own the formal quote.

Thanks — Alex

--

Hi Alex — thanks for the summary, helpful. Confirming the items you asked for: 

Projected monthly tokens (steady-state assumptions):
- Conservative: 8–12M/month
- Target (expected after Q2 ramp): 18–25M/month
- Aggressive (enterprise rollout): 40–60M/month (12–18mo outlook)

Budget range for year 1: approximately $4,000–$7,500/month for API spend. We can stretch if the unit economics clearly improve with commitments.

Startup program: we are seed stage (VC-backed, < $3M ARR), so interested in any founder/seed credits or early-stage sweeteners. Procurement contact is looped for PO/tax info.

Two clarifying Qs: 
1) When you say per-1M rates, are those already inclusive of caching/batching assumptions? We have a fair amount of prefix reuse during triage.
2) For multi-year incentives, do you typically require a revenue commit or token-commit schedule?

Thanks — Sonia

Hi Sonia — great, thanks for the detail. Quick answers then a high-level proposal so you have something to review this week. 

Q1 (caching/batching): our per-1M token cost examples assume conservative prefix/KV cache savings (we model ~10–20% token reduction for typical triage workloads). If you can provide sample prompt sets we can quantify further.

Q2 (multi-year incentives): we usually structure multi-year incentives around committed token spend (tokens/month * months) with optional milestone forgiveness for growth phases. We can do ramp schedules (e.g., 50% year1, 100% year2) for early-stage customers.

Attached are two artifacts: Commitment_Scenarios.xlsx (three tiered commitment bands with per-1M token rates and example monthly billing lines) and Startup_Program_Terms.pdf (how our seed/early credits layer into committed pricing). [attachment: Commitment_Scenarios.xlsx (xlsx, 55KB)] [attachment: Startup_Program_Terms.pdf (pdf, 120KB)]

High-level sketch (ballpark numbers, line items simplified):
- On-demand baseline: $1,200 / 1M tokens (no commitment) — for reference only.
- Tier A (small commit): 10M/mo committed -> $900 / 1M tokens (12-month) — ~25% off on-demand.
- Tier B (growth commit): 20M/mo committed -> $650 / 1M tokens (12-month) or $600/1M (24-month with addl rebate) — ~45–50% off on-demand.
- Tier C (enterprise anchor): 50M+/mo committed -> $420 / 1M tokens (24-month) + volume rebates at milestones.

Startup credit note: qualifying seed founders get a one-time credit that reduces the first 3 months of committed payments dollar-for-dollar (we've modeled a $10k credit in the attached example if you qualify).

Next recommended steps: 
- If Tier A or B looks reasonable for your Year 1 budget, Ben (cc) can pull together a formal quote + draft SOW + PO instructions.
- If you want a tighter per-1M estimate factoring your prompt samples, send a small sample set and Marissa can run a quick delta on cache impact.

Ben — can you pick this up for formal quoting? Sonia — any preference on a 12 vs 24-month structure given your current runway assumptions?

Thanks — Alex

--
